title: Saul's Death and Burial
description: The story of how King Saul and his sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malki-Shua fell in battle against the Philistines on Mount Gilboa. Saul was wounded by archers and threw himself upon his own sword when his armor-bearer refused to kill him. The Philistines plundered the dead, fastened Saul's skull in the temple of Dagon and his weapons in the temple of the gods. The men of Jabesh-gilead retrieved the bodies and buried the bones under the terebinth tree at Jabesh. The chapter concludes with a theological reflection: Saul died because of his unfaithfulness to the Lord, and the kingdom was transferred to David.
